about: Fixed, deterministic eval of the reference twin for the invented persona in persona/knowledge.json. Kinds: approved = the approved answer word for word; topic = the fixed answer for that topic; premise = a false premise corrected from the record; line = a fixed redirect line (injection, human, greeting, direct, offLimits); model = an open question the rules must pass to the model; output = a bad model reply that finishAnswer() must put right. {{EMAIL}} and {{PHONE}} are filled with fictional strings at run time.
